series.name: KSG 25-40K three-phase grid-tied PV inverter
series.notes: Commercial three-phase string inverter, 1100 V max DC. Table is Table 8.1 'Trouble shooting' in manual chapter 08. IMPORTANT per-series conflict: the M6 / Ver 2.0 manual gives F24 = 'Isolated island Fault' and F27 = N line-to-earth high, with F07 insulation threshold 50 KOhm. The earlier KSG-(25-40)KT Ver 1.0 manual (202201) for the same model numbers gives F24 = 'DSP Operation Fault' and no F27, with F07 threshold 500 KOhm. Never read F24 without knowing which manual revision the unit shipped with. F00-F03 and F04-F05 are printed as ranges in the manual; each individual code in those ranges carries the range's description.

title.ur: AC voltage ya frequency range se bahar (F00)

meaning.en: Mains voltage or frequency on the AC side is too high or too low, so the inverter cannot grid-connect.
meaning.ur: AC side par mains voltage ya frequency bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Grid voltage or frequency outside the local safety standard for this region.
causes.ur: Grid voltage ya frequency is ilaake ke local safety standard se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC output cable not properly connected, so the inverter reads the wrong mains value.
causes.ur: AC output cable theek se nahi lagi, is liye inverter galat mains value parh raha hai.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage with a multimeter against the local safety standard.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se local safety standard ke mutabiq mains voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC output line is properly connected and measure its output voltage.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC output line theek se lagi hui hai aur uska output voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter to see if the code clears.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein taake pata chale code chala ya nahi.

notes.en: Manual prints this row as the range F00-F03, so F00, F01, F02 and F03 all share this description.
notes.ur: Manual yeh row F00 se F03 ke range par likhta hai, is liye F00, F01, F02 aur F03 sab ka hal yehi hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

title.ur: AC voltage ya frequency range se bahar (F01)

meaning.en: Second code in the F00-F03 mains out-of-range group.
meaning.ur: F00 se F03 mains range ke group ka doosra code.

causes.en: Mains voltage outside the local safety standard.
causes.ur: Mains voltage local safety standard se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC output line impedance or loose terminal causing a bad reading.
causes.ur: AC output line ka impedance ya dheela terminal bure reading ki wajah se.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage with a multimeter and confirm it is inside the accepted window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se mains voltage check karke confirm karein ke yeh accepted window ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter, then re-read the code.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur code dobara parh lein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

title.ur: AC voltage ya frequency range se bahar (F02)

meaning.en: Third code in the F00-F03 mains out-of-range group.
meaning.ur: F00 se F03 mains range ke group ka teesra code.

causes.en: Mains voltage or frequency outside the local safety standard.
causes.ur: Mains voltage ya frequency local safety standard se bahar hai.

causes.en: Grid disturbance such as a large motor starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Grid par disturbance, jaise usi feeder par koi bada motor start hona.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage and frequency with a multimeter and log them for a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se mains voltage aur frequency check karein aur kuch minute tak note karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter; if the grid is genuinely unstable, escalate to the utility.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein; agar grid sach mein unstable hai to power company ko baat karein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

title.ur: AC voltage ya frequency range se bahar (F03)

meaning.en: Fourth code in the F00-F03 mains out-of-range group.
meaning.ur: F00 se F03 mains range ke group ka chautha code.

causes.en: Mains voltage or frequency outside the local safety standard.
causes.ur: Mains voltage ya frequency local safety standard se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC output wiring not terminated properly at the inverter's AC terminal.
causes.ur: AC output wiring inverter ke AC terminal par theek se nahi lagi.

solutions.en: Power down and tighten all AC output terminals, checking for loose or burnt connections.
solutions.ur: Power down karke saare AC output terminals kass lein aur dheele ya jale hue connections dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input, restart the inverter and re-check.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein, inverter restart karke dobara check karein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is above its allowed voltage. The manual prints F04-F05 as one 'too high or too low' row.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus apni ijazat se zyada voltage par hai. Manual F04 se F05 ko aik hi 'zyada ya kam' row mein likhta hai.

causes.en: Input mode set wrong, so the bus is charged from an unsuitable source.
causes.ur: Input mode galat set hai, is liye bus aik aise source se charge ho raha hai jo theek nahi.

causes.en: PV string voltage above the inverter's MPPT operating range.
causes.ur: PV string voltage inverter ke MPPT operating range se upar hai.

solutions.en: Check the setting of input mode and correct it.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string open-circuit voltage with a multimeter and compare it with the 1100 V max DC input.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se PV string ka open circuit voltage check karke 1100 V max DC input se compare karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter to see if the fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein taake pata chale fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is below its allowed voltage.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus apni ijazat se neeche voltage par hai.

causes.en: Input mode setting is wrong so the bus is fed from the wrong source.
causes.ur: Input mode setting galat hai is liye bus galat source se chal raha hai.

causes.en: PV irradiance too low for the bus to build up to operating voltage.
causes.ur: PV ki roshni itni kam hai ke bus operating voltage tak nahi chala.

solutions.en: Check the setting of input mode and correct it.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter; test again in full daylight.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein; poori dopahar mein dobara test karein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The DC bus is not balanced between phases or rails.
meaning.ur: DC bus phases ya rails ke darmiyan balance nahi hai.

causes.en: Input mode setting incorrect, so the inverter is not sourcing the bus as designed.
causes.ur: Input mode setting galat hai, is liye inverter bus ko design ke mutabiq supply nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Bus capacitor or balancing circuit has degraded with age.
causes.ur: Bus capacitor ya balancing circuit umar ke saath degrade ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the setting of input mode first and correct any mismatch.
solutions.ur: Pehle input mode ki setting check karein aur koi bhi mismatch theek karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter to confirm the fault is not transient.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein taake confirm ho ke fault momentary nahi tha.

solutions.en: If F06 returns on every boot, the bus capacitors need distributor replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar F06 har boot par wapas aaye to bus capacitors distributor se badalne hain.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: PV insulation to ground is too low, so the inverter will not connect to the grid. This is the code Kstar shows when an earth fault occurs.
meaning.ur: PV ka ground se insulation bohat kam hai, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi hoga. Earth fault aane par Kstar yehi code dikhata hai.

causes.en: Damp or damaged panel back sheet leaking to frame or ground.
causes.ur: Geeli ya kharab panel back sheet frame ya ground par leak kar rahi hai.

causes.en: PV connector not fully mated, or cable insulation stripped onto the frame.
causes.ur: PV connector puri tarah nahi laga, ya cable ki insulation frame par utar chuki hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter to see if the fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein taake pata chale fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the impedance of PV+ and PV- to ground; this manual says it must be over 50 KOhm.
solutions.ur: PV+ aur PV- ka ground se impedance check karein; yeh manual kehta hai ke yeh 50 KOhm se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If the reading is good but F07 stays, inspect every MC4 by disconnecting strings one at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar reading theek hai magar F07 bana rahe to strings aik aik karke har MC4 check karein.

notes.en: THRESHOLD CONFLICT: the KSG manual specifies 50 KOhm, the BluE-S/BluE-G manuals specify 500 KOhm for the same code F07. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: THRESHOLD CONFLICT: KSG manual 50 KOhm kehta hai, BluE-S aur BluE-G manual 500 KOhm kehte hain aik hi code F07 ke liye. CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The inverter is drawing more input current than it is allowed to.
meaning.ur: Inverter apni ijazat se zyada input current kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Input mode setting wrong, causing the inverter to expect a lower limit.
causes.ur: Input mode setting galat hai, jis se inverter ko kam limit ka intezaar hai.

causes.en: PV array over-sized for this inverter, e.g. array kW exceeds inverter kW ratio limits.
causes.ur: PV array is inverter ke liye bada hai, maslan array kW inverter kW ratio se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check the setting of input mode and correct it.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Count the PV strings and measure each string's current against the per-MPPT limit in the spec table.
solutions.ur: PV strings ginein aur har string ka current spec table ke per-MPPT limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter to see if the fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein taake pata chale fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: A hardware-level overcurrent was detected inside the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar hardware level par overcurrent detect hua.

causes.en: Output short circuit or an abnormally heavy load on the AC side.
causes.ur: AC side par output short circuit ya bohat bada load.

causes.en: Inverter hardware current sense has drifted out of tolerance.
causes.ur: Inverter ka hardware current sense tolerance se bahar chala gaya hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter after a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Kuch minute baad PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC output and confirm the inverter fault clears with no load connected.
solutions.ur: AC output band karein aur confirm karein ke koi load na hone par inverter ka fault chala jata hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Inverter output current has gone above the set threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output current set threshold se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: AC output shorted or a very heavy load on the output terminals.
causes.ur: AC output short hai ya output terminals par bohat bada load.

causes.en: Grid voltage collapse forcing the inverter to push more current.
causes.ur: Grid voltage gir gayi, jis se inverter ko zyada current push karna pada.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter after a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Kuch minute baad PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC output completely and retry to separate a load fault from an inverter fault.
solutions.ur: AC output poori tarah disconnect karke dobara try karein taake load fault aur inverter fault mein farq ho sake.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The DC-side current inside the inverter is above the limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar DC side current limit se upar hai.

causes.en: Inverter DC-DC stage or its current sensing has drifted.
causes.ur: Inverter ka DC-DC stage ya uska current sensing bigad gaya hai.

causes.en: PV inrush at start-up on a cold morning.
causes.ur: Thande subah start-up par PV ka inrush.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter after a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Kuch minute baad PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If F11 returns every boot, the DC stage needs distributor repair - not a field fix.
solutions.ur: Agar F11 har boot par wapas aaye to DC stage ki distributor se marammat hogi - yeh field par hal nahi hota.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Ambient temperature around the inverter is above the working range.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ambient temperature working range se upar hai.

causes.en: Inverter in direct sun or inside a poorly ventilated enclosure.
causes.ur: Inverter seedhi dhoop mein ya kam hawa wali enclosure mein hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature genuinely above the specified operating range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature waqai specified operating range se upar hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and let the inverter cool down, then restart it.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter thanda hone dein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit with a thermometer and compare to the manual's range.
solutions.ur: Unit ke paas thermometer se ambient temperature check karke manual ke range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Install a sunshade and keep clearance around the unit as per the manual's location rules.
solutions.ur: Sunshade lagayein aur manual ke location rules ke mutabiq unit ke aas paas saaf rakhay rakhein.

notes.en: The KSG manual spells this 'Amb Temperature Over'; the BluE manuals use 'Ambient Over Temp' for the same idea.
notes.ur: KSG manual isay 'Amb Temperature Over' likhta hai; BluE manual wahi cheez 'Ambient Over Temp' kehta hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink is too hot, so it has stopped to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka heatsink bohat garam hai, is liye usne apni hifazat ke liye ruk kar band kar diya.

causes.en: Cooling fan failed or blocked by dust and debris.
causes.ur: Cooling fan kharab hai ya dhool-mitti se block hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature outside the normal working range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature normal working range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and let the inverter cool down, then restart it.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter thanda hone dein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the fan spins freely by hand and clean dust off the heatsink fins.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke dekhein ke fan haath se aazad ghoomta hai aur heatsink ki fins se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature and confirm it is inside the manual's range.
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature check karke confirm karein ke yeh manual ke range ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The AC output relay has failed, so the inverter cannot connect to or disconnect from the grid.
meaning.ur: AC output relay kharab hai, is liye inverter grid se connect ya disconnect nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Relay coil, driver or contacts failed, often after a grid outage or lightning surge.
causes.ur: Relay coil, driver ya contacts kharab, aksar grid outage ya bijli ke surkh ke baad.

causes.en: A phase line is missing at the grid side, which the manual calls out explicitly.
causes.ur: Grid side par koi phase line missing hai, jisay manual saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether a phase line is missing, such as R, S, T phase, using a multimeter on all three phases.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se teenon phases par check karein ke koi phase line missing to nahi, jaise R, S, T.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: PV input voltage is too low for the inverter to run.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage itna kam hai ke inverter nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: One of the PV inputs is idle while the inverter is set to parallel mode.
causes.ur: Inverter parallel mode par set hai magar aik PV input idle hai.

causes.en: Low irradiance, heavy cloud or shading on part of the array.
causes.ur: Low irradiance, bhaari baadal ya array ke kisi hisse par shading.

solutions.en: Check the configuration of PV input; one PV input is idle when the inverter is set on parallel mode.
solutions.ur: PV input ki configuration check karein; parallel mode par aik PV input idle rehta hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure each string's voltage with a multimeter and identify any string sitting at or below the 250 V start voltage.
solutions.ur: Har string ka voltage multimeter se check karke woh string dhoondein jo 250 V start voltage par ya neeche ho.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

title.en: Remote Off - inverter switched off remotely (F16)
title.ur: Remote Off - inverter remote se band (F16)

meaning.en: The inverter was turned off by monitoring software. This is not a hardware failure - someone or some software switched it off.
meaning.ur: Inverter monitoring software se band kiya gaya hai. Yeh hardware ki kharabi nahi - kisi ne ya kisi software ne band kiya.

causes.en: The inverter is on remote OFF status; it can be turned on or off remotely by monitoring software.
causes.ur: Inverter remote OFF status par hai; isay monitoring software se on ya off kiya ja sakta hai.

causes.en: A monitoring app scheduled shutdown, or the logger lost its cloud link and dropped the unit.
causes.ur: Monitoring app ne shutdown schedule kiya, ya logger ka cloud link toot kar unit drop kar gaya.

solutions.en: Open the monitoring app or web portal and check whether a remote shutdown is scheduled.
solutions.ur: Monitoring app ya web portal kholein aur dekhein ke koi remote shutdown set hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Send a remote ON command from monitoring software and confirm the unit starts.
solutions.ur: Monitoring software se remote ON bhejein aur confirm karein ke unit start ho gaya.

notes.en: Listed in the KSG trouble shooting table but it is a state, not a fault - the inverter is fine and simply off.
notes.ur: KSG trouble shooting table mein likha hai magar yeh koi fault nahi - inverter theek hai aur bas band hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Internal SPI link between the inverter's control boards has failed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke control boards ke darmiyan internal SPI link kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Control board to DSP SPI link failed after a power surge.
causes.ur: Power surge ke baad control board se DSP ka SPI link kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Firmware version mismatch between ARM and DSP after an incomplete update.
causes.ur: Adhoora update ke baad ARM aur DSP ke firmware versions mein farq.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the fault survives a clean restart, only the distributor can reflash or replace the board.
solutions.ur: Agar fault clean restart ke baad bhi rahe to sirf distributor board reflash ya badal sakta hai.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Insulation leakage current on the PV or AC side is too high.
meaning.ur: PV ya AC side par insulation leakage current bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: AC cable or PV input line has abnormal insulation.
causes.ur: AC cable ya PV input line ki insulation abnormal hai.

causes.en: Moisture on connectors, or cable pinched by the enclosure metalwork.
causes.ur: Connectors par namak ya enclosure ki metal ke darmiyan cable pinch hua.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable and PV input line have abnormal insulation, especially at the outdoor glands.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC cable aur PV input line ki insulation normal hai ya nahi, khaas kar outdoor glands par.

solutions.en: Test insulation resistance of the AC cable with a megohmmeter after full isolation.
solutions.ur: Puri tarah isolate karne ke baad megohmmeter se AC cable ki insulation resistance test karein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The inverter's own leakage current self-test did not pass.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka apna leakage current self-test pass nahi hua.

causes.en: Residual current sensor drift or the sensor's reference circuit has failed.
causes.ur: Residual current sensor drift ho gaya ya uska reference circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Persistent external leakage that never quite reaches the trip level.
causes.ur: Barafi bahar ka leakage jo kabhi trip level tak nahi pohanchta.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact the local distributor - the self-check circuit is not field serviceable.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to local distributor se rabta karein - self-check circuit field par repair nahi hota.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Voltage consistency between parallel units or between phases is outside limits.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ya phases ke darmiyan voltage consistency limit se bahar hai.

causes.en: In parallel operation, master and slave voltage references have drifted apart.
causes.ur: Parallel operation mein master aur slave ke voltage reference alag ho gaye hain.

causes.en: AC phase sequence or neutral wiring incorrect at the grid end.
causes.ur: Grid end par AC phase sequence ya neutral wiring ghalti hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: On a parallel system, verify phase sequence and that all parallel communication cables are seated.
solutions.ur: Parallel system mein phase sequence check karein aur saare parallel communication cables lagi hain ya nahi.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Frequency consistency between parallel units is outside limits, so the units cannot share load.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan frequency consistency limit se bahar hai, is liye units load share nahi kar sakte.

causes.en: One parallel unit has lost its grid reference and is free-running.
causes.ur: Aik parallel unit ka grid reference chala gaya hai aur wo free-run kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency unstable, so parallel units see different frequency.
causes.ur: Grid frequency unstable hai, is liye parallel units ko alag frequency mil rahi hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a multimeter; if the grid is stable, isolate parallel units one by one to find the odd one.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se grid frequency check karein; agar grid stable hai to parallel units aik aik karke alag karke dhoondein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

title.en: F24 - isolated island or DSP op fault (by revision)
title.ur: F24 - island ya DSP fault (manual revision par munhasir)

meaning.en: M6 and Ver 2.0 manuals: the inverter detected it has become islanded from the grid. KT Ver 1.0 manual for the same models: the DSP has reported an operation fault.
meaning.ur: M6 aur Ver 2.0 manual: inverter ne detect kiya ke wo grid se island ho gaya hai. KT Ver 1.0 manual unhi models ke liye: DSP ne operation fault report kiya hai.

causes.en: Grid has gone down or opened; the inverter correctly refuses to stay connected.
causes.ur: Grid chala gaya ya khul gaya; inverter sahi tarah connected nahi rehna chahta hai.

causes.en: Grid-side relay or anti-islanding detection circuit has drifted (the KT Ver 1.0 reading of this code).
causes.ur: Grid side relay ya anti-islanding detection circuit bigad gaya hai (yeh KT Ver 1.0 ka matlab hai is code ka).

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency; if the grid is healthy, treat the KT-version reading as a DSP fault and contact the local distributor.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage aur frequency check karein; agar grid theek hai to KT version ka matlab DSP fault hai aur local distributor se rabta karein.

notes.en: MAJOR CONFLICT - two meanings for one code, same model numbers. M6/Ver 2.0 = 'Isolated island Fault'; KT Ver 1.0 (202201) = 'DSP Operation Fault'. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: BADA CONFLICT - aik code ke do matlab, wohi model numbers. M6/Ver 2.0 = 'Isolated island Fault'; KT Ver 1.0 (202201) = 'DSP Operation Fault'. CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: The inverter has detected a fault in its IGBT power stage.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne IGBT power stage mein fault detect kiya hai.

causes.en: IGBT has failed short or open, often from a surge or from running too hot.
causes.ur: IGBT short ya open ho gaya, aksar surge se ya zyada garam chalne se.

causes.en: DC bus capacitor failed, forcing the IGBT to absorb the fault current.
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor kharab ho gaya, jis se IGBT ko fault current sahnana pada.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the fault survives, contact the local distributor - IGBT replacement is a bench job.
solutions.ur: Agar fault bacha rahe to local distributor se rabta karein - IGBT badalna bench ka kaam hai.

notes.en: F26 is ABSENT from the KSG-(25-40)KT Ver 1.0 and BluE-G 3000-6000D-M1 fault tables. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: F26 KSG-(25-40)KT Ver 1.0 aur BluE-G 3000-6000D-M1 ke fault tables mein maujood hi nahi. CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: KSTAR User Manual KSG(25-40K-M6) EN Ver:1.0 (202505)

meaning.en: Neutral-to-earth voltage has risen above the protection value.
meaning.ur: Neutral se earth ke darmiyan voltage protection value se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: The machine's ground is not bonded to the power grid's ground.
causes.ur: Machine ka ground power grid ke ground se bonded nahi hai.

causes.en: N conductor has opened or is badly connected, so neutral has floated.
causes.ur: N conductor khul gaya ya buri tarah laga hai, is liye neutral float kar gaya.

solutions.en: Check whether the ground of the machine is connected to the ground of the power grid.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke machine ka ground power grid ke ground se jura hua hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the N-to-ground voltage with a multimeter; it should be well below the protection value.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se N se ground ka voltage check karein; yeh protection value se kaafi neeche hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Power down and tighten the AC neutral terminal, then re-test.
solutions.ur: Power down karke AC neutral terminal kass lein aur dobara test karein.

notes.en: F27 exists ONLY in the KSG(25-40K-M6) / KSG(25-40K) Ver 2.0 tables. It is absent from KSG-(25-40)KT Ver 1.0 and from the whole BluE-G family. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: F27 sirf KSG(25-40K-M6) ya KSG(25-40K) Ver 2.0 tables mein hai. KSG-(25-40)KT Ver 1.0 aur poore BluE-G family mein yeh maujood hi nahi. CONFLICTS dekhein.

meaning.en: The inverter has lost communication with its DSP controller.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne DSP controller se communication kho di hai.

causes.en: Internal comms board or ribbon link between comms board and DSP has failed.
causes.ur: Internal comms board ya comms board se DSP ka ribbon link kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Control supply rail on the comms board has collapsed.
causes.ur: Comms board ka control supply rail gir gaya hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV input and restart the inverter and check whether fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the fault returns on every boot, only the distributor can replace the comms or DSP board.
solutions.ur: Agar fault har boot par wapas aaye to sirf distributor comms ya DSP board badal sakta hai.
